# Overview

## What this is
A three-file Terraform configuration: a root module (`main.tf`) that declares one provider and calls two child modules, `modules/app` and `modules/network`. Neither child module takes input variables, produces outputs, or calls another module.

## Context
- A human operator is the only actor evidenced; there is no CI/CD config in the repo (no `.github/workflows`; `reference/delivery.md` found none), so `terraform plan`/`apply` is presumed run by hand. GAP: the actual apply process (local CLI, wrapper script, or an external CI system not in this repo) is not recorded here.
- The only declared target is AWS, region `us-east-1` (main.tf:11), via `hashicorp/aws ~> 5.0` (main.tf:2-6).
- No `backend` block is declared, so Terraform state defaults to a local `terraform.tfstate` file in whatever workspace runs `apply`; there is no remote backend or state locking.
- No `.terraform.lock.hcl` is committed, so the resolved provider version is not pinned in the repo.

## Module graph
```mermaid
flowchart LR
  root["root — main.tf"] --> app["module.app — ./modules/app"]
  root --> network["module.network — ./modules/network"]
```
| module | source | called from | resources |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| root | (this repo) | — | none directly |
| app | ./modules/app | main.tf:18-20 | 2 `aws_instance` |
| network | ./modules/network | main.tf:14-16 | 1 `aws_vpc` |

Full generated tables (providers, resources, module edges): `reference/infra.md`.

`modules/app` and `modules/network` do not reference each other and share no visible wiring (e.g. no subnet/VPC id passed from network to app) — each is a flat, self-contained resource block with no `variable`, `output`, `data`, or `locals`.

## Rendered views
Rendered C4 context/container/component views could not be produced: LikeC4 (`likec4@1.59.3`) is fetched via `npx` from the npm registry, and outbound network access to `registry.npmjs.org` was denied in this environment (see `docs/architecture/_run/kit-issues.md`). The module graph above and `reference/infra.md` are the accurate substitute for this run.

## Unknowns (GAP)
Everything below is absent from the checked-in code, not inferred:
- **Apply/deploy process** — no CI workflow, Makefile, or script invokes `terraform`; how and by whom `apply` is run is unknown.
- **AWS credentials** — the `provider "aws"` block sets only `region`; no `access_key`, `profile`, or `assume_role` is present, so how the operator authenticates to AWS is unknown. See `secrets.md`.
- **State backend intent** — no `backend` block; whether local state is intentional or an oversight is unknown.
- **Environments/workspaces** — no `variable` blocks, `.tfvars` files, or Terraform workspaces exist, so there is no visible way to target more than one AWS account/region.
- **AMI validity** — both `aws_instance` resources use `ami-123456` (modules/app/main.tf:2,7), which is not a well-formed AWS AMI id (too short); whether this is a placeholder is unknown.
- **Decision history** — no `docs/decisions/` ADRs exist; see `docs/decisions/README.md`.
- Additional open questions are tracked in `_run/interview.md` after stage 2.
